instruction: Start playing a playlist on Spotify that has enough songs for my workout today. I do not want to have to change the playlist in the middle of my workout. The workout plan is in Simple Note.
notes: Knowledge chain: show_profile gives the login username, show_account_passwords the passwords, get_current_date_and_time the weekday (2023-05-24 is a Wednesday). search_notes with query 'workout' discovers the workout-plan note id; show_note, combined with the known weekday and the static plan-duration fact, yields today's workout duration. show_playlist_library lists playlists and their song ids; summing song durations is modeled without numerics as an ordered chain of show_song calls per playlist (song-to-check/followed-by, last song wraps to the first), so play_music on a playlist requires its last song's duration to be known (hence all songs looked up) and the static long-enough fact relating the playlist to the workout duration. play_music(playlist_id) replaces the queue with the playlist and starts playing, matching the evaluation (player playing, queue == playlist songs, total duration >= workout minutes). The actual number of songs/playlists is unknown; two songs and one distractor playlist are representative. supervisor-complete-task takes the played playlist as a non-API record parameter so its precondition equals the goal; no answer is passed since the task is not a question.
